For visitors

Sign the group’s waiver (linked on the Meetup event) and RSVP. No helmet, no ride. Front and rear lights and plenty of water.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it’s a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the meet time. Tell whoever’s leading that you’re new.
Pace
Relaxed, stops as needed. It’s no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That’s the point of a group ride.
Check
Check the links below the day of for cancellations and weather calls.

First group ride? Start here →

About the Whatever You Feel Like Ride group ride

Whatever You Feel Like Ride is a social and e-bikes welcome group ride in Peoria, AZ. It rolls every Thursday at 7:00 pm from Rio Vista (the Meetup venue is Biscuits Cafe).

A Thursday night ride on whatever bike you have: fixies, mountain bikes, e-bikes, gravel, road, trikes. It covers 10–18 miles after dark from Rio Vista in Peoria and stops as needed for water. Nobody gets left behind.
